programme.title: Disco Dancer
programme.desc: Anil, a street performer with a tragic childhood, becomes India’s finest disco dancer. Tragedy strikes when he loses his mother in a staged accident. Now, he must not only fight his past demons but also confront the man determined to ruin his life.

programme.title: Rajnigandha
programme.desc: Deepa (Vidya Sinha), a highly qualified girl with simple dreams, is betrothed to Sanjay (Amol Palekar), a forgetful, tardy but lovable and caring boyfriend. Deepa goes to Mumbai for a job interview and chances upon Navin (Dinesh Thakur), her old boyfriend from college who was a passionate youngster and has now become a responsible and successful man. Through the course of the story, Deepa finds herself caught in a dilemma as she reminisces her past with Navin and her future with Sanjay. Will Navin's sudden appearance in her life change her heart?

programme.title: Ek Chitthi Pyar Bhari
programme.desc: Dr. Sunil Sharma hires a young nurse Aarti who had responded to his clinic's ad posted in a newspaper. He starts developing feelings for her and his mother also wants them to get married soon. However they are completely unaware of her dark past.

programme.title: Zulmi
programme.desc: Balraj looks after his boss' orphaned grandson Nihal along with his own daughter Komal. Upon growing up Balraj hires a street fighter named Raj as Komal's bodyguard not knowing that Raj is desperately searching for Nihal to kill him.

programme.title: Abhimaan
programme.desc: Subir, a popular singer in show business, encourages his wife and a talented singer, Uma to take up singing as a career. However, his pride is wounded and their marital bliss is threatened when Uma's popularity surpasses his own.

programme.title: Amar Akbar Anthony
programme.desc: A family of five is separated in an unfortunate incident. The three brothers are raised in different religious households. As fate would have it, the family reunites after several years and avenges those responsible for their separation.
